name: v0.8.1
body:
**New Features:**
- Added fallback logic for missing `/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt` ([#100](https://github.com/VHSgunzo/sharun/issues/100))
- Make `en_US.utf8` locale on the spot ([#92](https://github.com/VHSgunzo/sharun/issues/92))

**Improvements:**
- Handled `imlib2` ([#101](https://github.com/VHSgunzo/sharun/issues/101))
- Added `host dri` to `LIBVA_DRIVERS_PATH` only when Nvidia is in use ([#99](https://github.com/VHSgunzo/sharun/issues/99))
- Set `AMDGPU_ASIC_ID_TABLE_PATHS` ([#98](https://github.com/VHSgunzo/sharun/issues/98))

**Dependencies:**
- Updated `flate2` from `1.1.8` to `1.1.9` in [`Cargo.toml`](Cargo.toml)

**Code Refinements:**
- Minor changes

name: v0.3.1
body:
* Send output from all `_msg()` functions to `stderr`
* Add option `-t, --strace-time 5      Specifies the time in seconds for strace mode (env: STRACE_TIME=5)`
* Add options for packing with [wrappe](https://github.com/VHSgunzo/wrappe):
```
    -o, --with-wrappe        Pack with wrappe from PATH or env or download
                                (env: WITH_WRAPPE=1, WRAPPE=/path|URL, WRAPPE_URL=URL)
    -c, --wrappe-clvl 0-22   Specify the compression level for wrappe (env: WRAPPE_CLVL=0-22) (default: 8)
    -x, --wrappe-exec name   Specify the name of the wrappe packaged executable (env: WRAPPE_EXEC=name)
    -m, --wrappe-args 'args' Specify the args for the wrappe packaged executable (env: WRAPPE_ARGS='args')
    -u, --wrappe-no-cleanup  Disable cleanup the wrappe unpack directory after exit (env: WRAPPE_CLEANUP=0)
                                It can also be set at runtime (env: STARTPE_CLEANUP=0)
```
